label: Shopify product export
cadence: Monthly or before a product batch
how_to_export: Shopify Admin > Products > Export > All products > CSV for Excel, Numbers or other spreadsheet programs. Date = the day you exported.

label: Site URL list
how_to_export: One row per URL from the sitemap. Columns: type,url. type is homepage, collection, product, blog or page.

label: Current meta and content
how_to_export: Columns: url, meta_title_current, meta_description_current, content_current. From a Shopify export or a meta crawl tool.

label: Top sellers of one collection
how_to_export: Shopify Analytics > top products of the collection. Columns: url,title. Name = the collection handle.

label: Search Console - queries
how_to_export: Search Console > Performance > Search results > date range: 7 days > Queries tab > Export > CSV. Date = last day of that week.

label: Search Console - pages
how_to_export: Same 7-day range as the queries export > Pages tab > Export > CSV. Date = last day of that week.

label: Search Console - page by query
how_to_export: Needs page and query in the same table: use the Search Console API, Looker Studio or Search Analytics for Sheets (dimensions page + query, 7 days). The normal Export button cannot produce it.

label: Rank tracking
how_to_export: Rank tracker export for the mapped main keywords. Columns: keyword, url, position, search_volume, date.

label: GA4 - organic landing pages
how_to_export: GA4 > Reports > Engagement > Landing page > filter Session default channel group = Organic Search > whole month > Share > Download CSV.

label: Ahrefs - keyword export
how_to_export: Ahrefs > Keywords Explorer > paste the seed list > the client's country > Matching terms > Export CSV (choose UTF-8). Keep the Lowest DR and intent columns.

label: Ahrefs - backlinks
how_to_export: Ahrefs > Site Explorer > the client's domain > Backlinks > Export CSV (UTF-8).

label: Ahrefs - link intersect
how_to_export: Ahrefs > Link Intersect > targets = the competitors in the profile > but does not link to = the client's domain > Export CSV (UTF-8).

label: HTML samples (view-source)
how_to_export: In the browser open view-source:URL, select all, save as .html. Raw source only, not the Inspect panel. 3-4 URLs per template (homepage can be 1), from the sitemap, without ?variant= or ?page=.

label: AI prompts to track
how_to_export: Columns: prompt_id, prompt, intent, cluster, priority.

label: AI citation checks
how_to_export: One row per prompt and engine (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews). Columns: prompt_id, engine, date, brand_mentioned, cited_url, competitor_cited, position.

label: Microsoft Clarity export
how_to_export: Clarity > Dashboard > Export for the month. Stored for later use; no workflow uses it yet.
